content.value: What are differences between velocity-compounding and pressure compounding steam turbine? Show that for frictionless and symmetric blading impulse turbine, the gross stage efficiency, $\eta _ { g s } = \eta _ { b } . \eta _ { n }$ , where $\eta _ { b }$ is the blading efficiency and $\eta _ { n }$ is the nozzle efficiency.
